title: One row of sources/image-analyses/<run>/analyses.jsonl
description: One analysis of one image (region 0) or of one region of it, under one analyzer. (sha256, region, analyzer) is unique across the store: a run never sends an image that already has one.

region.description: 0 is the whole image; others are numbered by the detect analysis that made them

out.description: the answer: a triage or observation object (photo-rules/schemas), a description, boxes, or for embed a pointer to its vector row
